messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD service=gpupool-edge-usw1 - GPU_KERNEL_ALLOC_FAILURE spike (33/min). Affected pool: gpu-edge-us-west-1a. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456
sophie: acked on PD :thumbsup: I'm taking first pass. pinging infra if we need node-level ops
jamal: oncall here, what services are impacted? any customer-facing 5xxs?
sophie: quick look at traces — embed-service and rerank show elevated 5xx and timeouts. 95th latency up ~2.4x. Affected replicas pinned to node-edge-07.
sophie: running checks now
sophie: ```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep embed
embed-svc-7f8d   Running   1/1   2d   10.10.7.23   node-edge-07
embed-svc-7f8e   Running   1/1   2d   10.10.7.24   node-edge-08
```
jamal: can you ssh to node-edge-07 and check GPU processes / nvidia-smi?
sophie: sshing, grabbing nvidia-smi
sophie: ```
# nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv
pid, process_name, used_memory
4213, python, 23765 MiB
4220, python, 24012 MiB
# dmesg | tail -n 10
[ 12345.678901] cuda: [GPU0] Out of memory allocating 2048MB
[ 12345.679002] nv_alloc: failed, returning -12
```
jamal: looks like OOM on that GPU. Any recent model rollouts or big-batch jobs scheduled there?
sophie: no recent deploys in the last 6h. There's a heavier-than-usual batching spike from a customer job — spikes align with batch size ~1024 tokens. I'm temporarily throttling that route.
infra-lead: incoming. If node-level mem fragmentation causing OOMs we might need an orderly drain/restart. Suggest cordon node-edge-07 and shift traffic.
sophie: prepping commands, will cordon and move a portion of traffic to fallback model variant first (quantized_small)
sophie: ```
kubectl cordon node-edge-07
node/node-edge-07 cordoned
kubectl drain node-edge-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
Warning: some pods failed to evict, will retry
```
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: alert auto-escalated to infra-lead after 5m without resolved status
infra-lead: I see repeated cuda alloc failures in journal. dmesg shows kernel messages about GPU driver retries. Plan: 1) shift 30% of traffic to quantized fallback, 2) cordon+drain node-edge-07, 3) reboot GPU driver on node-edge-07, 4) rejoin after smoke tests.
sophie: applied router change: fallback rollout 30% -> quantized_small. Sending curl to router admin
sophie: ```
# curl -X POST -d '{"route":"embed","fallback":"quantized_small","pct":30}' https://router.internal/config
{"status":"ok","change_id":"chg-8342"}
```
sophie: monitoring metrics — error rate dropping from 18% -> 9% within 90s. latency 95th trending down.
jamal: good. continue with drain + reboot when safe.
sophie: drain completed for evictable pods. one stateful job held, I've evicted and recreated on node-edge-08.
sophie: rebooting GPU driver now (`sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced && sudo rmmod nvidia_uvm && sudo modprobe nvidia_uvm`)
infra-lead: leaving note — watch for kernel oops. if driver restart doesn't clear, plan B is full node reboot.
sophie: driver restart succeeded, `nvidia-smi` now shows clean memory footprint and no OOM messages. GPU memory usage stable ~3GB.
incident-bot: auto-shedder triggered earlier and reduced batch size on problematic route from 1024 -> 512 for 10m window
jamal: customer impact assessment: two mid-market customers (~5% of embed QPS each) saw elevated errors for ~7m window. We're notifying CSMs. No GDPR/PII exposure.
sophie: creating incident record: INC-2024-332, summary + mitigation actions added. linking PD incident PD123456.
jamal: preparing handoff to night oncall @maria — will include checklist (what's been done, nodes cordoned, fallback in place, incident links)
sophie: handoff note: node-edge-07 cordoned and driver restarted; drained; traffic fallback 30% to quantized_small; error rate back to baseline; incident ticket INC-2024-332 created; PD incident PD123456. Next steps: monitor for 30m, if errors reappear, escalate to hardware team and schedule node reboot.
maria: acked — I'll take watch. quick Q: which logs to check if it flares again?
sophie: check these first: `kubectl logs -n inference deploy/embed-svc`, `journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -k`, `dmesg | grep -i cuda`, router admin panel change_id `chg-8342` for fallback rollback
maria: got it. I'm taking over and will post any updates. thanks
pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD123456 acknowledged by sophie and status set to acknowledged
incident-bot: incident marked resolved after metrics stable for 15m; closing thread. If errors spike, PD will reopen automatically.
